summary: Two-story Cal Fire lookout built in 1935 near Mariposa; removed in 2017-18, and only its stairway remains.

corrections.why: NHLR gives Removed 2017-18 and the FFLOS page says sometime between 2017 and 2018, so a single year understates the range.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: NHLR names the Madera-Mariposa-Merced Unit (Cal Fire MMU); the FFLOS page names the Mendocino Unit (Cal Fire MEU) while giving Mariposa County as the location. Not resolved by any source; the story reports both names.
NHLR records removal in 2017-18 and FFLOS says only the stairway remains; the Gazette says the 2017 Detwiler Fire reduced the tower to ashes. No source resolves this, so the story reports both.

sources.title: Williams Peak: Sure cure for cabin fever

notes_for_editor: Four online sources. The Gazette piece is subscription-gated and undated; only its opening paragraph was read. The 1935 and 1936 newspaper items are reprinted on the Forest Lookouts page and were not checked against the original papers. Access today is not described by any source, so the story says nothing about visiting. Elevation 977 m in the record matches the FFLOS and NHLR figures. Do not confuse with the Idaho Williams Peak lookout (a 1932 L-4 cab in Payette NF), which is a separate record. No photos added. Fact-check 2026-10-09: the Gazette's 2017 Detwiler Fire account conflicts with the NHLR removal wording, and the story reports both. The events.removed correction (2017 to 2017-2018) is still pending human review.
